plan.failureSummary: The page.ai cached runSource used a stale structural CSS selector (#nav > nav > div:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(2) > button) which now matches the 'Solutions' dropdown item instead of 'Developers'. This caused the AI step to click 'Solutions' and navigate to '/solutions/use-cases/critical-user-flows/' instead of '/docs/', causing the url assertion to fail.
observedIndicators: Test instruction asks to click 'Developers' dropdown and navigate to 'Documentation'.
Cached runSource executed CSS selector '#nav > nav > div:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(2) > button'.
Tool logs show the clicked element was <button aria-controls="nav-dropdown-solutions">Solutions</button>.
Assertion expect(page.url()).toEqual('https://www.checklyhq.com/docs/') failed due to misdirected navigation.

remediationSteps.summary: Clear page.ai cache and retry test execution.
remediationSteps.details: Clear the deterministic cache for checkly.test.ts and re-run the test suite so page.ai re-evaluates the page navigation structure.

plan.notes: Clearing the page.ai cache will allow the AI agent to dynamically query the live DOM, correctly find the 'Developers' navigation button, and navigate to '/docs/'.
